name: Middleton FMC 2023
information:
This competition only holds the Fewest Moves Challenge Event and not the regular 3x3 event. You can find how it works [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MiddletonFMC2023#36676-what-is-fmc). There is no registration fee for this competition, so we highly recommend you give it a try!

On [Tuesday](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MiddletonMeetupTuesday2023) and [Thursday](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MiddletonMeetupThursday2023), we will be holding competitions with 3x3 at the same venue in the evening. Those competitions are in series with each other, but you are allowed to compete in one of those as well as this FMC competition. 

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
